story.iron_tide.arc.name: Iron Tide
story.iron_tide.arc.desc: An old coal tramp and a black tide that refuses to retreat.
story.iron_tide.cast.captain.name: The Captain
story.iron_tide.cast.captain.desc: An old captain who never gives a real name and knows every channel out of Ash Harbor.
story.iron_tide.cast.harbor_master.name: The Harbor Master
story.iron_tide.cast.harbor_master.desc: Harbor master of Ash Harbor; every sailing permit passes through their hands.
story.iron_tide.term.black_tide.desc: A rust-colored current that arrives from the eastern sea every autumn and swallows any ship that fails to get clear.
story.iron_tide.l01.name: First Smoke
story.iron_tide.l01.desc: The captain's first solo run: take on coal, leave port, and steam for Iron Bay.
story.iron_tide.l01.stage.opening.title: The Harbor Master's Orders
story.iron_tide.l01.stage.opening.body.0: "Six units of coal. No more, no less. The sea is quiet today, but the black tide does not wait."
story.iron_tide.l01.stage.closing.title: Leaving Port
story.iron_tide.l01.stage.closing.body.0: The funnel coughs out its first black smoke as Ash Harbor shrinks astern.
story.iron_tide.l01.brief.title: First Smoke
story.iron_tide.l01.brief.body.0: Ash Harbor's coal bunker holds barely a short hop. The harbor master wants six units aboard before you sail.
story.iron_tide.l01.brief.body.1: The supply station is just east of the quay. Load up, cast off, and don't linger in the fog.
story.iron_tide.l01.beat.farewell.title: The Harbor Master's Advice
story.iron_tide.l01.beat.farewell.body.0: "At Iron Bay, read the tide first and the price second. Don't get greedy."
story.iron_tide.l01.debrief.success.0: You reach Iron Bay ahead of the black tide with half the bunker still full.
story.iron_tide.l01.debrief.failure.0: The ship ran dry before it ever left port. Return to the checkpoint and try again.
story.iron_tide.l01.debrief.hook: In the Iron Bay shipyard, someone is waiting for this old coal tramp.
story.iron_tide.l02.name: Homeward
story.iron_tide.l02.desc: Return from Iron Bay to Ash Harbor and trade the last load of coal for supplies.
story.iron_tide.l02.stage.opening.title: Morning at Iron Bay
story.iron_tide.l02.stage.opening.body.0: The shipyard has packed the bunker full and marked the homeward route on your chart.
story.iron_tide.l02.stage.closing.title: The Lights of Ash Harbor
story.iron_tide.l02.stage.closing.body.0: The familiar lights come up ahead; this run was not wasted after all.
story.iron_tide.l02.brief.title: Homeward
story.iron_tide.l02.brief.body.0: Steam back to Ash Harbor. There is only one channel, but the weather will not spare your coal.
story.iron_tide.l02.debrief.success.0: You bring word of Iron Bay home to Ash Harbor. The story of the Iron Tide is only beginning.
story.iron_tide.l02.debrief.failure.0: The bunker ran empty and the ship stopped halfway. Try a leaner route next time.
story.iron_tide.l01.lock.reason: Loans are unavailable during the tutorial.
story.iron_tide.l01.task.name: Coal for the first voyage
story.iron_tide.l01.task.obj: Load 6 coal and reach Iron Bay
story.iron_tide.l01.focus.supply: Buy coal in the market supply block.
story.iron_tide.l01.focus.chart: Open the chart, pick Iron Bay and confirm departure.
story.iron_tide.l02.lock.reason: The shipyard is closed until you return home.
story.iron_tide.l02.task.name: Homeward to Ash Harbor
